researchQuestion: Can primary patch provenance and an unindexed firsthand cohort narrow the applicability of TWW conditional prospecting evidence without fabricating current expected quantities?

patchEpoch.change: Blizzard increased prospecting gem rates for Bismuth, Ironclaw Ore and Aqirite, affecting both baseline rates and item-quality effects.
patchEpoch.verifiedDateBasis: Blizzard-authored August 29 section of cumulative official hotfixes, NOT September 17 section and NOT article headline October 16.
patchEpoch.implementationCaveat: Hotfix page warns some changes require realm restarts or client updates; exact activation time/build not established.
patchEpoch.conclusion: Do not pool pre-hotfix and post-hotfix prospecting rates as one stationary study; patch date alone does not establish the actual cast epoch of a study.

originalCohort.note: Original author reports twenty five-ore stacks and totals; completed cast count, saved ore, output-rank detail and observation date were not recorded. Derived per-five-ore numbers are nominal ratios, NOT verified zero-inclusive expectedQuantity per actual completed cast.
originalCohort.negativeResultGuard: Zero Emeralds in 20 nominal five-ore equivalents does not establish P=0, output ineligibility, or absence of the Emerald specialization effect.

reusedSources.conclusion: Do not recount its two Aqirite ranks as new independent data.
Publication after hotfix is not proof of the time each cast occurred.
Pre-hotfix publication and descriptive specialization mapping are not current-patch rate evidence.
